name: Media Entity Podbean
description: adds a media source for embedding Podbean podcasts.
project_description:
Provides media source support for referencing podcasts and playlists from Podbean and embedding as oEmbed content in Drupal.

 If you are a user of the Podbean service (either free or paid) you can embed podcasts and playlists by pasting the permalink URL from Podbean to into the media entity and source this module creates for you.

 Note you must use a permalink URL from Podbean in the format

of https://www.podbean.com/e/12345 .

 See this link for more information on creating permalinks.
